title: 朝の準備
text: <ruby>私<rt>わたし</rt></ruby>は<ruby>毎朝<rt>まいあさ</rt></ruby><ruby>六時<rt>ろくじ</rt></ruby>に<ruby>起<rt>お</rt></ruby>きます。まず、<ruby>顔<rt>かお</rt></ruby>を<ruby>洗<rt>あら</rt></ruby>って、<ruby>歯<rt>は</rt></ruby>を<ruby>磨<rt>みが</rt></ruby>きます。それから、<ruby>制服<rt>せいふく</rt></ruby>に<ruby>着替<rt>きが</rt></ruby>えます。<ruby>朝<rt>あさ</rt></ruby>ご<ruby>飯<rt>はん</rt></ruby>はパンと<ruby>卵<rt>たまご</rt></ruby>とサラダを<ruby>食<rt>た</rt></ruby>べます。<ruby>七時半<rt>しちじはん</rt></ruby>に<ruby>家<rt>いえ</rt></ruby>を<ruby>出<rt>で</rt></ruby>ます。<ruby>学校<rt>がっこう</rt></ruby>まで<ruby>自転車<rt>じてんしゃ</rt></ruby>で<ruby>十五分<rt>じゅうごふん</rt></ruby>かかります。<ruby>八時<rt>はちじ</rt></ruby>に<ruby>学校<rt>がっこう</rt></ruby>に<ruby>着<rt>つ</rt></ruby>きます。<ruby>朝<rt>あさ</rt></ruby>はいつも<ruby>忙<rt>いそが</rt></ruby>しいです。

questions.question: What time does the narrator wake up?
What does the narrator eat for breakfast?
How does the narrator get to school?
How long does it take to get to school?

translation.en: I wake up at six o'clock every morning. First, I wash my face and brush my teeth. Then, I change into my school uniform. For breakfast, I eat bread, eggs, and salad. I leave home at seven thirty. It takes fifteen minutes to school by bicycle. I arrive at school at eight o'clock. Mornings are always busy.
translation.fr: Je me lève à six heures chaque matin. D'abord, je me lave le visage et je me brosse les dents. Ensuite, je me change en uniforme scolaire. Pour le petit-déjeuner, je mange du pain, des œufs et de la salade. Je quitte la maison à sept heures et demie. Il faut quinze minutes pour aller à l'école à vélo. J'arrive à l'école à huit heures. Les matins sont toujours chargés.
